column3: The card tool rows ship enabled and rely on #113's kernel tool_search; ctx.pi.search() and the shared hold are gone; the card tools' first sentences were shortened
column4: #113 offers tool_search whenever an extension carries a deferred tool, so the card rows only add their deferred-tools index lines. With the original first sentences those lines were 358 bytes and the delegated thread's first request measured 5,796 bytes against its 5,760 bound; shortening the first sentence of each card tool's description (the index's only text) brought them to 235 bytes and passes the bound unchanged
column5: plugins/approval/approval.test.ts 'add one deferred-tools index line per card tool and no declaration'; src/cost.test.ts green with the rows enabled
column6: adopted; spec 09-plugins § Cards cost; no cost bound was raised
